title: Hysab Kytab v1.0.8
message: Official Android VoiceInteractionService & Session Bottom Sheet overlay for long-press Home button (genuine Gemini AI experience), with zero full app launches.
changelog: Gemini AI floating bottom sheet slides up over active apps/home screen
Tap outside or swipe down to instantly dismiss without app switching
Live pulsing mic orb with generous speaking time and instant ledger recording
Open App shortcut button to transition to full ledger
